drive_sync.title: Sync to Google Drive
drive_sync.not_configured: Not set up: this build has no Google client ID, see the README.
drive_sync.signed_out: Not signed in. Results stay in this browser.
drive_sync.n_waiting: no results waiting | one result waiting | {count} results waiting
drive_sync.sign_in_again_hint: Google Drive sync: sign in again to go on. Results are kept until then.
drive_sync.problem_offline: No connection. Results are kept and sent when it is back.

drive_sync.sign_in_no_drive: Signed in, but without access to Google Drive. Sign in again and tick the box for Google Drive.
drive_sync.sign_in_failed: Could not sign in to Google:

smart_cube.connect_failed: Could not connect to the cube:

smart_cube.press_to_start: Press space or tap to start
smart_cube.press_or_turn_to_start: Press space, tap or turn U ×4 to start

solve_stats.moves_hint: Half turn metric: a double turn is one move, a slice move is two

stats_card.hold_spacebar_hint: Hold spacebar to start the timer

hotkeys.add_to_starred: Add selected case to starred preset
hotkeys.navigate: Navigate to prev/next/first/last result in stats

hotkeys.smart_cube_escape: Smart cube: drop the current attempt and pause (also D' ×4 on the cube)
